title: Guo et al., On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks

inspection: Personally read first page and definitions Section 2 (Eq.1 calibration, acc/conf bins, Eq.3 ECE, Eq.6 NLL); Section 4.2 temperature scaling Eq.9 and following paragraph; Section 5 calibration discussion. Local pdftotext ranges 1-100, 100-225, 218-260, 395-447, 495-519. Original PDF carries arXiv v2 identifier. Bin closure in paper is (left,right]; chapter deliberately states its own [left,right) closure, confirmed against real implementation.
scope: Calibration/reliability diagram and ECE definitions, positive shared-temperature scaling, validation NLL optimization, invariant class argmax; finite observations estimate calibration. Not the authority for this repository's six/14-sample performance, five-bin implementation, or binary Brier scaling.
